commons.description: Soldiers assigned to the 3d U.S. Infantry Regiment (The Old Guard) celebrate National American Indian Heritage Month at the Community Center on Joint Base Myer-Henderson Hall, Virginia, November 13, 2019. commons.title: Detail of 1608 Smith Map showing the Patawomeck River.jpg
commons.description: In 1608, Captain John Smith explored the river now known as the Potomac and made drawings of his observations which were later compiled into a map and published in London in 1612. This detail from that map shows his rendition of the river that the local tribes told him was called the "Patawomeck".
commons.editorial_reason: This is a historical map detail and does not visibly show Piscataway culture.
